methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly and re-verified on 2026-06-18: hihello.com/pricing, blinq.me/pricing, mobilocard.com/pricing, uniqode.com/pricing (and /digital-business-card), v1ce.co/pricing, popl.co/pages/pricing, and buy.linqapp.com. Compliance pages (hihello.com/security, blinq.me/security, mobilocard.com/security, uniqode.com/hipaa, popl.co SOC 2 blog) were fetched. IMPORTANT: popl.co/pages/pricing publishes NO individual plan prices — it shows only demo/usage-based team pricing — so Popl Pro ($7.99) and Pro+ ($14.99) are third-party-corroborated (digitalbusinesscard.com plus multiple 2026 reviews via WebSearch), not official. Linq's official site (linqapp.com / buy.linqapp.com) no longer displays DBC subscription prices after its 2025-2026 messaging-API pivot; Linq One ($29/seat/mo, $249/seat/yr) is third-party-corroborated (lynkle.com 2026 comparison plus multiple reviews). V1CE publishes prices only in GBP (Client Capture OS £49.99/mo; Smart Card from £75 one-time); no official USD is published, so monthlyUsd is null. All accessedAt = 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Popl
vendors.provenance: Popl's official pricing page (popl.co/pages/pricing) publishes NO individual plan prices — it shows only demo/usage-based team & event-lead-capture pricing. Individual plan prices (Free $0, Pro $7.99/mo, Pro+ $14.99/mo) are sourced from digitalbusinesscard.com/blog/popl-pricing and independently corroborated by multiple 2026 reviews via WebSearch (G2, Capterra, GetApp). SOC 2 Type 2 confirmed via popl.co/blogs/all/popl-soc-2-security.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 digital business card profile; QR code and personal link sharing; NFC sharing with purchased hardware; no lead capture or CRM integrations.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Up to 3 digital cards, two-way contact exchange, 5,000+ CRM integrations via Zapier, basic analytics, Popl branding removed. Annual billing: $6.40/month ($76.80/year). Price not published on popl.co; corroborated via third-party sources.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: Up to 5 digital cards, custom lead-capture forms, branded push notifications, unlimited device management, Popl AI tools for contact enrichment. Annual billing: $11.99/month ($143.88/year). Price not published on popl.co; corroborated via third-party sources.

plans.name: Teams / Enterprise (Event Lead Capture)
plans.notes: Usage-based pricing (pay per qualified lead captured, not per seat). No published price — demo/custom quote required. Includes unlimited events, AI badge scanning, data enrichment, CRM integrations, SOC 2 Type 2 security.
